body: T5 - SCORE VS TIME-PER-QUESTION OVERLAY SPEC. Note: MCM does not currently track time-per-question. This spec proposes adding it, then visualizing the overlay. PHASE 1 DATA: Add start-time tracking to exam.html. On question card first-focus or first-input event: record timestamp. On submit-grade: record total time per question as seconds between first-input and grade. Store in results JSON: add timeSeconds field to each question result. PHASE 2 VISUALIZATION: In index.html trend chart, add a secondary Y-axis (right side) showing avg time per question in seconds. Overlay: gray dashed line (not Pistons color to avoid confusion with RIB line). Domain: 0-120 seconds. INSIGHT VALUE: If Kai scores 100% but spends 8 minutes on one question, Marcus knows that question is fragile. If Kai speeds through a 40% section, he may be guessing. Time x accuracy is a better signal than accuracy alone. WHY THIS IS FUTURE SCOPE: Current JSON schema does not include timeSeconds. Adding it breaks no existing data. Old attempts just show zero. New attempts populate it. ACCEPT CRITERIA FOR PHASE 2: Secondary y-axis renders on right side. Time line is gray dashed distinct from score lines. Tooltip shows both score and time on hover. Does not appear if no time data exists.
